title: Common shared definitions
description: Language-neutral shared enums and primitives used across all contract schemas. These mirror the canonical values in packages/shared (TypeScript) and docs/firebase-data-model.md. iOS, Android, backend, and admin must all treat these values as the single source of truth.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID. Stable user identifier across the platform.

isoTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string (e.g. 2026-07-02T12:00:00Z). JSON serialization of Firestore server timestamps. Backend-generated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() — never trust client-supplied timestamps.

nullableIsoTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string, or null when the event has not occurred.

userRole.description: Backend-managed role. Never trust client-side role claims. The Firestore target model documents 'user' and 'admin'; 'owner' is an elevated backend-managed role retained from packages/shared/src/users.ts.

userStatus.description: Backend-managed account status. Suspended or deleted users must not access protected features regardless of other fields. Suspension always overrides subscription entitlement.

subscriptionEntitlement.description: Backend-managed subscription entitlement. Clients may use this for UX gating only — never for security enforcement.

authProvider.description: Supported sign-in identity providers. Provider subject is the stable identity key; email is a contact channel, not an identity key.
